card.name: Start of rare names, like pravastatin
card.fires_on: The first piece of a rare name, where the next piece is an unusual syllable. Mostly 'pr' at the start of pravastatin, also 'Cl' in Clinitek and 'Gu' in Gudden.

modes.label: Pravastatin start
modes.description: The 'pr' that begins pravastatin in lists of statins.

modes.label: Other rare proper names
modes.description: The first piece of an uncommon brand or person name, such as a lab analyzer, an anatomist or a pub.

card.writes: It suppresses odd foreign-script tokens and promotes 'inspir-' words, which looks like noise rather than a useful output effect.
